node.title: Re: How to get last month date using Date::Calc
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
use warnings; use strict; use Date::Calc qw/Add_Delta_YM/; sub prevmonth { my ($year, $month) = @_; my ($newyear, $newmonth, undef) = Add_Delta_YM( $year, $month, 1, 0, -1 ); return [$newyear, $newmonth]; } use Test::More; is_deeply prevmonth(2003,8), [2003,7]; is_deeply prevmonth(2004,1), [2003,12]; done_testing;

Update: This is also possible with the core module [doc://Time::Piece]. If you have a modern browser like the latest Firefox or Chrome, [https://webperl.zero-g.net/democode/perleditor.html#%7B%22script%22%3A%22use%20warnings%3B%5Cnuse%20strict%3B%5Cnuse%20Time%3A%3APiece%3B%5Cn%5Cnwhile%20(%3C%3E)%20%7B%5Cn%5Ctchomp%3B%5Cn%5Ctmy%20%24t%20%3D%20Time%3A%3APiece-%3Estrptime(%24_%2C%20'%25m%2F%25Y')%3B%5Cn%5Ctmy%20%24prev%20%3D%20%24t-%3Eadd_months(-1)%3B%5Cn%5Ctprint%20%24prev-%3Estrftime('%25m%2F%25Y')%2C%20%5C%22%5C%5Cn%5C%22%3B%5Cn%7D%22%2C%22script_fn%22%3A%22prevmonth.pl%22%2C%22inputs%22%3A%5B%7B%22fn%22%3A%22months.txt%22%2C%22text%22%3A%228%2F2003%5Cn1%2F2004%22%7D%5D%2C%22cmdline%22%3A%22perl%20prevmonth.pl%20months.txt%22%7D|here is a live demo of the following code].

use warnings; use strict; use Time::Piece; while (<>) { chomp; my $t = Time::Piece->strptime($_, '%m/%Y'); my $prev = $t->add_months(-1); print $prev->strftime('%m/%Y'), "\n"; }
